name: Data Recipe: Hiring-signal alert for target companies

parameters.content:
## Hiring-signal alert for a list of companies
Every morning the [Job Search API](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/job-search-api) reads the career pages (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters) of the companies you watch. Only postings you have not seen before are kept, logged to Google Sheets and summarised in Slack.

**Setup (5 min)**
1. *Get open roles*: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
2. Edit `companies` (`greenhouse:stripe`, `lever:palantir`, `ashby:ramp` or careers URLs).
3. Connect Google Sheets (tab `Jobs`) and Slack.

Note: the first run reports everything posted in the last 2 days as new.
Cost: $0.0025 per job returned. 3 companies = roughly $0.03/day.

nodes.name: Get open roles
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/job-search-api and returns its dataset. The JSON body is the Actor input - edit it freely.
